ruleset.name: EventKoiLite
ruleset.description: EventKoi Lite ruleset. Intentionally narrower than Pro's: Lite has never been linted, and the full WordPress standard reports ~3.3k errors, nearly all of them cases Pro already adjudicated with phpcs:ignore annotations that Lite's drifted copies never received. This scope covers the sniffs that catch real defects. Widen it toward Pro's ruleset as the annotations are ported.
